CHIEF DECISION: seal CostBreakdown in the current P0 successor rather than defer it. Convert it to a bare-private final non-case class with explicit accessors, full structural equality/hash, intentional toString, and checked construction only. Removal of copy/unapply/Product/Mirror is intended. Compile-refusal courts must cover constructor/apply/copy/fromProduct/Mirror from both an open-package attack and unrelated consumer package. This is limited to CostBreakdown; the five sibling types remain on bd-01M17ZNXY6AS1CMBQJRH3JMNVX.

The SupportAssessment wire may omit derived share or carry it only as a redundant value checked bit-for-bit against recomputation from canonical measuredTerms and exact eligible weights. Unestablished reason is also derived. Same path envelope; no docs widening. An explicit dependency on bd-01M1D214VVRE118RTEQQ09P7SA now enforces the documentation landing order.
